method: Original SF2 -> 48 kHz stereo; 80-ms Hann, 15 partials, nominal +/-2% F0 search. 10-ms RMS; no effects or normalization before measurement.

capture.conversion: Each note directly from original SF2 PCM to 48000 Hz; no intermediate-rate source. Stereo and SF2 envelopes retained. No per-note normalization.
